recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow active-source cleanup that brings the current core Transport narrative into line with the completed workflow-alignment family; any future work on retired or incubator OO resources should happen in their owning build or repository.
issue_request: FHIR-19631 is an Applied OO Persuasive with Modification umbrella issue to complete workflow-pattern alignment for OO resources by creating and completing resource-specific QA tickets.
initial_application: The issue was not applied by one FHIR-19631 source commit. It was applied through child/resource tickets, including Transport through FHIR-43448/FHIR-50911, DiagnosticReport through FHIR-43443/FHIR-50597, and other workflow-mapping tickets.
additional_context: Confluence minutes confirm FHIR-19631 was the all-OO umbrella ticket and could close only once child workflow tickets were complete. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Transport active, while SupplyRequest, SupplyDelivery, DeviceUsage, DeviceDispense, and BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense are not active core resources in this checkout.
reconciliation: Updated source/transport/transport-introduction.xml to say Transport is an event resource from a FHIR workflow perspective and removed the obsolete clause saying OO intended to align it later. Out-of-build resource introductions were intentionally left unchanged.
